_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_sph#16. The phantom-key half is COUNTED over the trees, not asserted: SOUNDSPEED and SMOOTHING_LENGTH appear in zero files of 4C's src and SOUNDSPEED in zero of its decks. (Both names were served as required SPH material keys in this repo until 2026-08-07.) EQUATIONOFSTATE_IN_UPSTREAM_SPH_DECKS=0 shows every upstream SPH deck leaves the default. The inertness half is a bit-comparison of the verdict lines with REFDENSFAC and EXPONENT perturbed under IdealGas, guarded by IDEALGAS_SELECTED and TAIT_KEYS_PERTURBED so a silently failed edit cannot masquerade as inertness. Unlike the DEM restitution fixture, the mutation here DOES discriminate on the physics claim: it removes the IdealGas switch, so both decks are GenTait, the Tait keys become live and the identity breaks. IGNORED_KEY_IS_STILL_REQUIRED=yes records the trap that a key IdealGas ignores is still mandatory for the material parser.
